signIn.title: Sign in to {{academyName}}
signIn.subtitle: Access your courses and track your progress.

signUp.title: Join {{academyName}}
signUp.subtitle: Create your student account to start learning with {{academyName}}.
signUp.success: Sign in to continue. If this email is new to Atlas, your account is ready. If you already have an Atlas account with this email, sign in with it — we've emailed you how to continue.
signUp.successExistingAccount: You already had an Atlas account with this email — it now has access to this academy. Sign in with your existing password.
signUp.joinedVerify: {{academyName}} has been added to your Atlas account. Confirm it's you to continue.
signUp.joinedPending: Your request to join {{academyName}} has been sent. You'll be able to sign in once the academy approves it.
signUp.welcomeTitle: You're all set — {{academyName}} has been added to your Atlas account
signUp.welcomeOtherAcademies: You already use this Atlas account with {{academies}}. You don't need a separate account: {{academyName}} is now part of the same one.
signUp.welcomeSeparate: Your courses, progress and certificates in each academy stay separate.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the email you use at {{academyName}} and we will send you a reset link.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Pick a password you have not used before.
resetPassword.invalidTitle: This reset link is invalid or has expired
resetPassword.invalidDescription: Reset links can only be used once and expire after a short time. Request a new one to continue.

verifyEmail.title: Verifying your email
verifyEmail.verifying: One moment while we confirm your email address…
verifyEmail.successDescription: You can sign in and start learning.
verifyEmail.errorTitle: We could not verify this link
verifyEmail.errorDescription: This verification link is invalid or has already been used. Request a new one from your account.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.description: This academy's website hasn't been published yet. Please check back soon — there will be something here shortly.
